summary: Issue relations need list, add and remove commands that name both issues and report each relation from the named issue's side, so blocked-by is the inverse of a Linear blocks relation and never a separate type.
reason: The v4.9.0 reprint dropped the earlier issue_relations commands, which left agents without the Linear app no way to record or read blocked-by dependencies; a swapped issueId/relatedIssueId inverts the blocker silently.
validated_outcome: Stub GraphQL tests fail when the blocked-by mapping or the inverse labels are swapped; strict trust mode refuses dry-runs and live writes alike with no request sent.
